change_summary: The journal published an expression of concern for this paper. It says the editors have been made aware of concerns about some of the data reported, and that the matter is being looked into. The notice does not say which data are in question, and no later notice resolves it.
evaluation: Your Discussion cites Lopez and Chen [8] as showing reduced activity in recipient mice, and says your own proposal builds on this finding. The journal has issued an expression of concern saying the editors have been made aware of concerns regarding some of the data, and that the matter is being looked into. The notice does not say which data are involved, so it is uncertain whether the transplant result you rely on is touched. If it is, the effect on your Discussion would be moderate.
recommendation: Hedge the Discussion's use of Lopez and Chen [8] and cite the notice, because the editors have been made aware of concerns regarding some of the data and the notice does not say which data are in question. Don't build your proposal on this finding while the matter is being looked into.
